prompt:
Review this screen for usability, and also check the colour contrast and the ARIA attributes:

output:
Contrast, focus styles, spacing scales, semantics, ARIA and screen-reader output are not part of this review. ## UX review: screen with "You are on the Free plan." and "Upgrade plan" Reviewed: Code of one screen, covering a plan status line and one clickable "Upgrade plan" element. Main goal: Upgrade plan (the only action on the screen) Steps to main goal: 1 (the screen with "Upgrade plan") Findings: 1 (S1: 0, S2: 1, S3: 0, S4: 0) ### Findings 1. **"Upgrade plan" control** | S2 Major | R-ux-review-1 - Evidence: "
Upgrade plan
" - Shown absent: The element's style gives it no border, no fill and no underline, so nothing sets it apart from the plain text line above it. - User experiences: The user reads "Upgrade plan" as another line of text, does not see it as something to click, and looks elsewhere for a way to upgrade. - Recommendation: Make the "Upgrade plan" control look clickable, with a button shape or a link appearance that differs from the status text above it. ### Not reviewed - Contrast, focus styles, spacing and type scales: a visual polish pass. - Semantics, ARIA and screen-reader output: an accessibility audit. - Wording of labels and messages: a copy edit. ### Open questions - "Upgrade plan" control: what the user sees after clicking it, and whether a loading state appears if it takes more than 1 second; the input does not show what openPlans() does. - "Upgrade plan" control: the width and height of its target in px; no size is stated. - Main goal: is upgrading the plan what the user comes to this screen to do, and how many steps follow after "Upgrade plan" before the upgrade is complete? ### Severity scale - S1 Blocker: the user cannot complete the main goal, or loses data or money. - S2 Major: the user completes the main goal only after a wrong action, an error or a second attempt. - S3 Minor: the user completes the main goal at the first attempt, but more slowly. - S4 Note: the result and the speed do not change; the place departs from the rule.
